data.body: Repair applied at 2026-09-08T14:03Z: restarted only the Gerrit container to reload the already-materialized rotated replication deploy key. Gerrit came back healthy (HTTP /login returned 302 by the third 5s probe) and replication plugin loaded. Then triggered `replication start --all --remote github --now --wait` via Gerrit SSH. Immediate verification: GitHub main now equals Gerrit main at cc3b80b4a084716c52194f40d98208f487c07e91; post-restart replication_log window has no publickey/auth errors. Continuing to verify Mirror Guard/CloudWatch and prevention/RCA details before close.
